purpose: Owner-selected household, preflight and whale integration; existing graphics stack and platform pins retained.

decisions.native_held_art: Owner requests volumetric hand models for AgriCraft and Animal Husbandry useful handhelds, retaining native state graphs and ordinary icons except a redesigned greenhouse-monitor icon. Fowl genetics appearance remains a required compatibility adapter.
decisions.grooming_quality: Owner chose effectiveness. Native grooming fully resets dirt, so only happiness gains scale with quality; wear stays native.
decisions.agricraft_tools: Owner chose native clippers, rakes and trowel without reforging. Informational/storage utilities retain native behavior.
decisions.seasons: Ecliptic Seasons is selected future work, currently absent; no seasonal restrictions or speculative adapter added.
decisions.maps: Native Xaero terrain display on new selection; FOLLOW/MANUAL controls retained. Native Xaero preferences are not overwritten.
decisions.ah_fresh_animations: Owner explicitly authorizes use of AH x FA1.1. Original provider ARR terms and file provenance remain unchanged; owner approval does not assert upstream relicensing.
decisions.whale_dimensions: Develop thirteen Overworld ecological forms now. Nether and End whales are owner-selected future work during those dimension updates, with no current spawn there.
decisions.held_native_identity: Latest owner review narrows corrections to three aspects: frontal horned bull-skull ledger emblem; tidy greenhouse-monitor case/face junction with graphs retained; inward brush bristles (right hand leftwards, left hand rightwards). Do not apply broad reinterpretations from the agent audit to accepted or unreviewed items.
decisions.whale_materials: Owner explicitly requires the actual recognizable Minecraft block materials, consistent block-scale16texels/worldblock detail, and integrated mob eyes. Rejected coarse invented moss/basalt patterns and pasted gray native eye rectangles. Compose from installed block textures at runtime; no bundled Minecraft/NStexture derivatives.

accepted_appearance: Shown magnifier appearance (no further redesign requested for either magnifier).
Shown AgriCraft seed-bag appearance; unshown states are not individually accepted.

accepted_aspects.animalhusbandry:brush: Shape accepted; correct the holding direction only.
accepted_aspects.agricraft:greenhouse_monitor: Graphs/scales and general form accepted; refine outer case/face assembly only.

selected_corrections.animalhusbandry:farm_ledger: Frontal bull skull with horns, not a profile animal face.
selected_corrections.animalhusbandry:brush: Bristles point inward in each hand, retaining accepted mesh.
selected_corrections.agricraft:greenhouse_monitor: Integrated, tidy case/readout junction, retaining approved graphs.

held_owner_review.other_items: Unreviewed by owner; retain current forms. Agent correspondence audit does not override scoped acceptance.
held_owner_review.limits: Appearance decisions do not establish live client, animation, controls or shader acceptance.

agricraft_filter.counts: 18 native resource plants and18 mutations; retain vanilla/FD food and decorative definitions.

integration.troughs: Fill-only water capability conserves native bucket=16drinks in fractional internal units; food transfer remains separate; partial buckets cannot yield free water.
integration.cheese: Only AH slices join c:cheeses. Do not put AH block into shared cheese_block recipes that assume a different portion yield.
integration.preflight: Read-only snapshots of actual tracked connected bodies, pressure-adjusted support mass, gas and inspectable Create Simulated fuel. No cargo-inventory mass or flight range claim.
integration.whales: Thirteen saved/synced ecological forms chosen by actual loaded habitat. Four bounded forward placements, 56–72 default distance, complete multipart clearance, Overworld only. Ordinary chunk unload saves whales; beyond128 default distance they leave only after2400 continuously distant ticking calls, reset on return. No forced chunks or blanket persistent flags.
integration.grooming: Six paid qualities use existing fixed probabilities; legendary has natural weight0 and remains available in paid reforging. Native full cleanliness reset and durability preserved, happiness scales .75/1/1.25/1.5/2/2.5.
integration.eggs: Keep both native AH/FD egg smelting recipes; AH fried eggs join FD c:foods/cooked_egg and Create Food cooked_eggs, powderable_eggs and egg_burrito_ingredients so either furnace result remains useful in shared food recipes.
integration.whale_travel_coordinates: Exact Sable2.0.6 normalizes player passengers to world coordinates at positionRider/rideTick TAIL; Create seats may retain plot coordinates, minecraft:player does not. Native player XYZ/AABB therefore remain correct aboard a vessel. SimulationDistance6 remains; complete candidate chunk checks precede placement.
integration.chalk: White_chalk block unpacks to four chalk_powder, matching native four-powder compression; one powder yields one nonstackable chalk:chalk. Native calcite route remains. No damaged Chalk input or colored-block dye stripping. Native powder comes from brushing calcite buds/clusters.

fowl_assets.author: aqario and contributors
fowl_assets.method: Deterministic palette replacement and speckles retain native32x32 UV layout; adult and baby variants cover four AH colors and two patterns.

chalk.states: Core chalk tint and16 deprecated colour aliases; box glow predicate and selected chalk overlay remain native.
chalk.classification: Generated sprites deliberately retained; no model redesign selected.
chalk.reforging: Owner explicitly chose native chalk and chalk box without reforging or added quality effects.

animalhusbandry.classification: Five useful handhelds gain original volumetric hand models, ordinary icons and worn armor stay native. Care/consumable functions unchanged.
animalhusbandry.reforging: Brush has owner-selected grooming family; angora gear uses plain_armor byslot and angora_yarn. Ledger/magnifier informational items remain native.

agricraft.classification: Eight useful roots/eleven states gain volumetric hand models. Native ordinary icon/state routes remain, except independently authored greenhouse-monitor icon, which also persists when hand3D is disabled. Valve/analyzer native placed geometry retained.

agricraft.reforging: Owner keeps four gardening tools without reforging; this is independent of their new visual volume. Information/storage and consumable crop sticks retain native gameplay. Magnified helmets retain existing armor family.
